title: 1997 AHSME Problem 12
statement: If \(m\) and \(b\) are real numbers and \(mb\gt0,\) then the line whose equation is \(y=mx+b\) cannot contain the point

solutions.text: If \((1997,0)\) were on the line, then \(0=1997m+b,\) so \(b=-1997m\) and \(mb=-1997m^2\lt0,\) a contradiction. Each other point can occur for suitable same-sign \(m,b.\) Thus the correct answer is E.
hints: The condition \(mb\gt0\) means the slope and vertical intercept have the same sign
Substitute each point; a positive \(x\)-intercept forces the slope and intercept to have opposite signs
